newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyonnaise U.S. unit in management buyout. [CORRECTED 11:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Lyonnaise U.S. unit in management buyout. [CORRECTED 11:45 GMT]

text.p: Lyonnaise des Eaux said on Tuesday that its wholly-owned U.S. subsidiary Lyonnaise American Holding had agreed to sell its 80 percent stake in the company Aqua-Chem to a management buyout.

Lyonnaise would not disclose the terms but a spokeswoman said Aqua-Chem earned a net profit of $4.1 million (corrects from $6.5 million) last year on sales of $199 million, up nine percent on the previous year.

The sale of Aqua-Chem, which makes industrial water heaters and provides water treatment, to the Rush Creek firm controlled by Aqua-Chem's management and a venture capital group, is expected to close in mid-July, Lyonnaise said in a statement.
